title: ui: marketplace card and detail page show which languages an app ships (with coverage), and the catalog gets a languages filter (objectstack#30284 console half)
body:
repo:cloud#3 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BvRcDHXqRU4TSVE4u6

Filing gate: **(b) a split a dev report names**: objectstack#30284's cloud half is draft PR objectstack-ai/cloud#3803 (`Refs #30284`); its report names the console half as the split. The maintainer ordered the card (「立卡」 2026-11-05). Dedup: searched open objectstack issues for "marketplace languages", "supported_locales", "locale_coverage"; no hits.

Serial: after objectstack-ai/cloud#3803 merges and the cloud deploy that carries it (the fields below are served only from then). This card's landing closes objectstack#30284 together with it.

## 维护者速读

cloud#3803 让控制面在发布时测量每个版本实际带了哪些语言、每种语言翻译了多少，并在应用市场接口里返回，还加了 `?languages=` 筛选。这张卡做控制台这一半：应用市场卡片和详情页显示「中文 100% · 日本語 60%」，没有语言信息的旧版本显示「无语言信息」（绝不显示成"仅英文"），目录加一个语言筛选。

## What the API serves (cloud#3803)

On every served version (`latest_version` on a catalog item, and the version on the detail page), both keys always present:

- `locale_coverage`: `null` or `{ default_locale, expected_keys, locales: [{ locale, translated, coverage_percent }] }` (`coverage_percent` rounded to one decimal, the CLI's `coveragePercent`).
- `supported_locales`: `null` or the locales that carry text, the default first (BCP-47 as the app declares them, `zh-CN`).
- Catalog filter: `?languages=zh-CN,ja-JP` (OR inside the facet, AND with the other facets), and the facet counts under `languages`, keyed on the latest approved release. A package with no language information counts in no language; it is still listed when no language filter is set.

Read the merged cloud code for the exact shapes before building: `packages/service-cloud/src/package-locale-coverage.ts`, `routes/marketplace.ts`, `marketplace-catalog-filter.mjs`.

## Expected

- The marketplace card shows the shipped languages, by native name, with coverage (for example 中文 100% · 日本語 60%); the detail page shows the full list.
- `null` renders as "no language information" (translated), never as English only.
- A languages facet control beside the existing taxonomy facets, wired to `?languages=`.
- New strings in every locale pack the console ships.

## Done when

- Card, detail and facet render against a catalog with a measured version, an old (null) version and a filtered query, each pinned by a test; the console's i18n gates stay green.
